mapper.sql: USER_ID AS userId, EMAIL AS email, USER_NAME AS userName, STATUS AS status, USER_ROLE AS userRole, PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS profileImagePath, PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH AS profileOriginalImagePath, PROFILE_CROP_SCALE AS profileCropScale, PROFILE_CROP_X AS profileCropX, PROFILE_CROP_Y AS profileCropY, NVL(PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') AS profileAvatarType, TO_CHAR(BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birthDate, BIRTH_CALENDAR_TYPE AS birthCalendarType, BIRTH_PUBLIC_YN AS birthPublicYn
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_USER_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, EMAIL, PWD_HASH, USER_NAME, STATUS, USER_ROLE, PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, PROFILE_CROP_X, PROFILE_CROP_Y, PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, BIRTH_DATE, BIRTH_CALENDAR_TYPE, BIRTH_PUBLIC_YN ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{email}, #{pwdHash}, #{userName}, #{status}, #{userRole}, #{profileImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileOriginalImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileCropScale, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileCropX, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileCropY, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{profileAvatarType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DEFAULT'), CASE WHEN #{birthDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{birthDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, NVL(#{birthCalendarType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'SOLAR'), NVL(#{birthPublicYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y') )
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_PROFILE_IMAGES SET IS_CURRENT = 'N' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_CURRENT = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PROFILE_IMAGES ( PROFILE_IMAGE_ID, USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH, CROP_SCALE, CROP_X, CROP_Y, IS_CURRENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_USER_PROFILE_IMAGE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{profileOriginalImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileCropScale, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileCropX, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileCropY, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'Y', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{email})) AND PWD_HASH = #{pwdHash}
SELECT FROM USERS WHERE UPPER(EMAIL) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{email} || '%')
SELECT FROM USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{email}))
